t: The $(item)Charging Station/$ is a machine in which $(l:base_concepts/pressure)pneumatic items/$ can be charged (or discharged). The interaction between the $(item)Charging Station/$ and pneumatic items is the same as for the interaction between tubes/machines: differences in pressures will be equalized. This means that you'll need a well-pressurized $(item)Charging Station/$ to charge items fully.
$(item)充气站/$是一台可为$(l:base_concepts/pressure)气动物品/$充能（或放电）的机器。$(item)充气站/$与气动物品之间的交互方式，与管道/机器之间的交互相同：压力差会被均衡。这意味着，你需要让$(item)充气站/$保持足够高的压力，才能将物品完全充满。

Most charged items have a maximum pressure of 10 bar. Don't worry about explosions though; items will not explode due to overcharging, but simply stop charging beyond 10 bar.$(p)The $(thing)Charge Pad/$ can be camouflaged with a $(l:tools/camo_applicator)Camouflage Applicator/$.
大多数充能物品的最大压力为 10 bar。不过不用担心爆炸；物品不会因过度充能而爆炸，只会在超过 10 bar 后停止充能。$(p)$(thing)充电座/$可以使用$(l:tools/camo_applicator)伪装涂覆器/$进行伪装。

You can turn the $(item)Charging Station/$ into a $(thing)Charge Pad/$ by inserting a $(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)Dispenser Upgrade/$. This will (de)pressurize:$(li)items lying on the ground on top of the Charging Station$(li)items carried by players standing on the Charging Station$(li)all types of $(l:tools/drone)Drone/$ which are directly above the Charging Station
你可以插入一个$(l:base_concepts/upgrades#dispenser)发射器升级/$，将$(item)充气站/$变成$(thing)充电座/$。这会对以下对象进行（减）加压：$(li)位于充气站上方地面上的物品$(li)站在充气站上的玩家所携带的物品$(li)所有直接位于充气站上方的$(l:tools/drone)雄蜂/$

The $(item)Charging Station/$ also functions as a management system for items which accept $(l:base_concepts/upgrades)upgrades/$. To upgrade an item, put it in the $(item)Charging Station/$ as usual, and click the $(thing)up-arrow/$ button just above the item slot. This opens a new GUI where upgrades can be inserted; every applicable upgrade for the item in question is documented in a GUI side tab.
$(item)充气站/$还可作为可接受$(l:base_concepts/upgrades)升级卡/$的物品管理系统使用。要为物品安装升级卡，像往常一样将其放入$(item)充气站/$中，然后点击物品槽正上方的$(thing)上箭头标志/$按钮。这会打开一个新的 GUI，你可以在其中插入升级卡；该物品可用的所有升级卡都会记录在 GUI 侧边标签页中。
